required.cart_stop_watchdog: Measured cart startup, stopping corridor, watchdog/brake behavior and physical stop procedure are missing
required.loaded_arm_stop_hold: Loaded arm hold and fault-stop response at recorded voltage, payload and temperature need measurement
required.scene_stability: Measured scene clearance, payload demand and loaded support/stability review are missing
required.tool_alignment: Measured lens/light reference transforms and independent spatial residuals are missing
required.host_timing: Actual read/write timing and response lag under all three device workloads need qualification

operator_assumptions.cables: Ideal; no additional cable restriction inside calibration-defined joint position ranges
operator_assumptions.joint_position_limits: Original calibration minima/maxima; mechanical stops as stated by the operator
operator_assumptions.low_level_control: Existing onboard servo position control and motion profile; host sends position targets and monitors feedback

note: Each record requires a workspace-relative path and SHA-256 of a qualification document. Missing measurements are not replaced by historical true/false flags. See docs/robot-motion-execution.md.
